denominators.by_prefix_length_and_slot: Protected proposal occurrences at this physical block slot (1–15) and prefix length; slot 0 is the known seed and is excluded. Sums are not averages.
denominators.prefix_length_counts: Sampled block occurrences, including zero-length prefixes.
denominators.source_rows: Exactly one original response forward per presentation; no checkpoint recomputation or accumulation-row duplicate.
denominators.weight_moved: Sum of response-reported coefficient mass movement; not a model update norm.

interpretation: Intervention execution evidence only; no causal explanation follows from coefficient movement.
